open_questions: Which current literature/public dataset can provide source-qualified optical constants plus independent R/T or ellipsometry holdout without author contact?
If a candidate public dataset is found, what sample/stack, geometry, wavelength range, polarization, units, and leakage policy are source-proven?
Can Wang Fig2f-R.xlsx vertical offsets and measured-vs-simulated column assignments be source-backed without arbitrary fitting?
Can the thesis/exported Intensity columns be justified as absolute reflectance for Phase 3A?
What predeclared residual thresholds and wavelength window are defensible before any calibrated-evidence promotion?
Can a Woollam project file, plotting script, or lab note map the 30_20_10 exports to a sample and stack?

decisions.summary: GPD is a planning mirror, not the source of scientific authority.
decisions.rationale: Eternity claim status remains governed by repo docs, contracts, and src/eternity/claim_status.py.

decisions.summary: TiN/TiON optical constants can support calibration_only_no_holdout only.
decisions.rationale: No independent TiON R/T or ellipsometry holdout provenance is registered yet.

decisions.summary: Keep thesis d_10nm mapped to 3L2/Quartz, but do not map separate 30_20_10 exports to that sample without source evidence.
decisions.rationale: Thesis Table 4.1 and Figure 4.1 support d_10nm/3L2; the thesis and appendix do not source-confirm the separate Coding/txt filenames.

decisions.summary: Treat d_10nm exports as thesis Figure 4.1 provenance with relative_intensity_only normalization, not absolute calibrated reflectance.
decisions.rationale: The local figure and CompleteEASE screenshot match the table scale, but text exports still say Intensity and no absolute calibration proof was found.

decisions.summary: Phase 3A validation candidates are capped at weak_within_dataset_holdout.
decisions.rationale: Normalization certainty and predeclared thresholds are still missing, and residuals have now been inspected only under that capped status.

decisions.summary: Existing residuals are historical context only.
decisions.rationale: Threshold policy must apply to a future run unless it was recorded before the run being judged.

decisions.summary: Keep d_10nm exports at relative_intensity_only after local evidence/manual checks.
decisions.rationale: Thesis and figure evidence support measured reflectance provenance, but exported Intensity columns are not source-proven as calibrated absolute reflectance.

decisions.summary: Local retrieval did not find exact source-backed absolute %R evidence for d_10nm.
decisions.rationale: Related RC2/CompleteEASE and thesis provenance exists, but no exact export/project/recipe/lab-note proof ties the thesis Intensity columns to calibrated absolute reflectance.

decisions.summary: Related CompleteEASE/Woollam source candidates do not equal absolute reflectance proof.
decisions.rationale: The scanner found source candidates and stronger 3L2/Quartz provenance, but no readable metadata proves channel name, units, calibration state, angle, polarization, and exact sample identity for calibrated absolute reflectance.

decisions.summary: Source-candidate triage pivots to relative-only diagnostics.
decisions.rationale: The triage found useful quartz 10 nm dynamic manual-follow-up candidates, but no exact source identity or calibrated absolute reflectance proof.

decisions.summary: Relative-only diagnostics are descriptive, not validating.
decisions.rationale: Shape, dip, and trend agreement are useful context, but cannot become a pass/fail gate or calibrated-evidence promotion for the already-inspected run.

decisions.summary: Bounded manual source follow-up comes before Phase 3B return.
decisions.rationale: The follow-up has three concrete quartz dynamic candidates and Phase 3B still lacks raw TiON R/T.

decisions.summary: Manual source follow-up is packetized, not proven.
decisions.rationale: The packet guides review but does not prove absolute reflectance or source identity.

decisions.summary: Phase 3A source follow-up is exhausted.
decisions.rationale: The three bounded candidates are related provenance only; they do not prove exact source identity, absolute reflectance, or d_10nm source lineage.

decisions.summary: St Andrews public TiN is the next best validation lane.
decisions.rationale: It has paper-backed R/T and ellipsometry in one public dataset, but still needs exact pairing, leakage policy, and predeclared thresholds before calibrated promotion.

decisions.summary: St Andrews TiN can run as a fail-closed validation candidate.
decisions.rationale: Reflectance supports the 50 nm / 50 C candidate pairing well enough for a capped run, but not for calibrated promotion; R/T holdouts remain forbidden for fitting and thresholds are blocked.

decisions.summary: St Andrews residuals are historical context only.
decisions.rationale: A future threshold policy now exists, but it has applies_to_existing_run false and cannot promote run_42fe0ad6dd295019.

decisions.summary: St Andrews threshold-locked clean run failed.
decisions.rationale: Reflectance normalization is acceptable for this public dataset policy, but the current 50 C epsilon / RT.xlsx pairing fails all five predeclared metrics and is not Phase 4-ready.

decisions.summary: St Andrews failure triage points to source-model parity.
decisions.rationale: The failure is not a near miss; blue-edge residuals dominate, alternate tables do not pass, and simple thickness/substrate sweeps do not repair the shape.

decisions.summary: St Andrews source-model parity gaps are real but non-promoting.
decisions.rationale: The raw Woollam source model includes Float Glass Cauchy substrate, film-thickness/roughness metadata, and back-reflection settings absent from the clean run, but those gaps do not validate a replacement model or calibrated promotion.

decisions.summary: Bounded St Andrews source-model parity does not rescue the lane.
decisions.rationale: Source-derived variants still fail locked thresholds; roughness and back-reflection remain approximate, so stop before Phase 4 unless new source evidence appears.

decisions.summary: Local TiON validation evidence is exhausted.
decisions.rationale: TiON_48/TiON_49 epsilon tables and calibration-only examples are available, but no raw R/T measurements or repo-local plot candidates exist; the next validation-data path is literature/public search.

approximations.name: roughness_bruggeman_ema
approximations.description: Roughness is approximated as a 50/50 air-TiN Bruggeman EMA layer because the public packet does not expose an exact CompleteEASE roughness recipe.

approximations.name: incoherent_backside_estimate
approximations.description: Back reflection is approximated as a thick lossless glass layer with a glass-air backside because substrate thickness and exact CompleteEASE acquisition reduction are unavailable.
